subject: Custody & evidence handoff for Clearline throughput/latency incident
messages:
From: OpsLead <opslead@clearline-payments.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Performance spike — we need preserved evidence now

Soojin,

Thanks for the call earlier. We recorded a 35% error rate spike and sustained latency at >1.8s for a 45-minute window on 2028-03-28 17:40-18:25 UTC. Our security & legal teams are asking for an auditable export of all runtime artifacts related to that window — logs, sampling of request/response pairs (redacted PII), and the exact S3 paths to any preserved artifacts.

We need chain-of-custody and a statement of retention policy (how long Redwood will keep the preserved artifacts) because this is likely to be part of our postmortem and internal audit. Please confirm ETA and who will sign the custody docs.

— Sam (Clearline Ops)
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: OpsLead <opslead@clearline-payments.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Legal <legal@clearline-payments.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Performance spike — we need preserved evidence now

Sam —

We're on it. High-level plan:
- Produce a hermetic evidence bundle containing runtime logs, telemetry traces, and a CSV manifest that lists object keys and checksums.
- Apply a legal hold and mark the S3 snapshot as immutable for 180 days by default (we can extend on request).
- Provide a signed chain-of-custody PDF and a short statement describing retention and access controls.

ETA: initial bundle + manifest by Thu 2028-03-29 09:00 PDT; signed chain-of-custody by Fri 2028-03-30 EOD PDT.

Notes / ask for REDWOOD internal folks: Monica, can you prepare the manifest and include SHA256 checksums for each archived object? Marcus, can you snapshot the runtime node logs and KV cache traces and push to the evidence bucket with write-once ACLs? Rishi, please coordinate with Security on redaction guidelines for trace exports and confirm whether any requests require additional legal review.

I will loop in Legal at Clearline for signature logistics.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: OpsLead <opslead@clearline-payments.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Performance spike — we need preserved evidence now

On Wed, 28 Mar 2028 at 12:05 PM soojin_lee@redwood.com wrote:
> Sam —
>
> We're on it. High-level plan:
> - Produce a hermetic evidence bundle containing runtime logs, telemetry traces, and a CSV manifest that lists object keys and checksums.

Attached is the first-pass manifest and a small sample bundle (runtime-logs-20280328.tar.gz referenced below). The manifest lists 1,204 objects (application logs, trace snapshots, and API payload samples). We generated SHA256 checksums and recorded object sizes.

Access path (read-only): s3://redwood-evidence/clearline/2028-03-28/ (objects are in the attached s3-manifest-20280328.csv). Bucket policy applied: enforcement of object lock in governance mode and MFA delete for the snapshot.

Redaction: per Rishi's guidance we removed full card/PII fields from API payload samples and replaced them with consistent tokens (card_token_XXXX). We kept request/response timing, status codes, and model request metadata intact.

Attachments included: runtime-logs-20280328.tar.gz (4.2GB, samples), s3-manifest-20280328.csv

Next: Marcus will upload full archive and share pre-signed, time-limited download link; I'll collect the chain-of-custody signoff artifact and circulate.

— Monica
Principal Incident Coordinator
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: OpsLead <opslead@clearline-payments.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Audits Team <audits@acme-audits.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Evidence bundle & signed custody document (Clearline incident 2028-03-28)

Sam / Clearline Legal —

Deliverables attached and available for download:
- runtime-logs-20280328.tar.gz (S3 snapshot + node-level logs)
- s3-manifest-20280328.csv (object list + SHA256)
- chain_of_custody_signed.pdf (signed by Redwood Security Officer)

Pre-signed download (expires in 7 days): https://s3.redwood.com/evidence/clearline/2028-03-28/download?signature=EXAMPLE-TOKEN

Retention statement: By default Redwood will retain the preserved evidence in immutable object lock for 180 days. If Clearline requests extension for regulatory/audit reasons, Redwood will update the retention window and obtain written authorization. Access is restricted to: Redwood Security, Incident Response, and a named Clearline audit contact. All accesses are logged; we can provide an access audit report on request.

Chain-of-custody summary: bundle created 2028-03-29T02:12:00Z from live nodes; checksums generated with sha256sum v1.9; artifacts uploaded to evidence bucket with Governance Mode object lock; chain_of_custody_signed.pdf records the upload operator, timestamp, checksums, and the Security Officer signature.

If you need notarization / e-signature through DocuSign we can initiate that today — Monica has the template ready.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Runtime Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
